provenance.capturedViewWitness: Inputs captured in the paired actually executed authored facade; expected HTML/tree/errors/trace are the original lane unchanged. No new renderer oracle or normalized output.
provenance.limitations: Synthetic declared service ports. Host-detached case has original pre-parser assignment but no appended parsed tree. Direct hostile indicator title is a separately disclosed adapter fixture. Maintained tests use a unit fake clock only for object coercion chronology; no native capture clock is replaced.
